# The -definitions flag reports where each checked template was defined:
# the define clause, the template name, the matching end clause, and the
# quoted name literal inside the clause.
#
# "greeting" is reached through an ExecuteTemplate call and "name"
# through a {{template}} node, so both inspectors are exercised.

check-templates -definitions
cmpenv stdout want.txt
! stderr .

check-templates -definitions -o jsonl
cmpenv stdout want-jsonl.txt
! stderr .

# Without the flag nothing is written.
check-templates
! stdout .
! stderr .

-- want.txt --
$WORK/index.gohtml:1:1+21	"greeting"	$WORK/index.gohtml:1:46+7	$WORK/index.gohtml:1:10+10
$WORK/index.gohtml:2:1+17	"name"	$WORK/index.gohtml:2:28+7	$WORK/index.gohtml:2:10+6
-- want-jsonl.txt --
{"template_name":"greeting","define":{"filename":"$WORK/index.gohtml","line":1,"column":1,"offset":0,"length":21},"end":{"filename":"$WORK/index.gohtml","line":1,"column":46,"offset":45,"length":7},"name":{"filename":"$WORK/index.gohtml","line":1,"column":10,"offset":9,"length":10}}
{"template_name":"name","define":{"filename":"$WORK/index.gohtml","line":2,"column":1,"offset":53,"length":17},"end":{"filename":"$WORK/index.gohtml","line":2,"column":28,"offset":80,"length":7},"name":{"filename":"$WORK/index.gohtml","line":2,"column":10,"offset":62,"length":6}}
-- go.mod --
module example.com/app

go 1.25.0
-- main.go --
package main

import (
	"embed"
	"fmt"
	"html/template"
	"net/http"
)

var (
	//go:embed *.gohtml
	source embed.FS

	templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(source, "*"))
)

type Page struct {
	Title string
}

func handleIndex(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	_ = templates.ExecuteTemplate(w, "greeting", Page{Title: "Home"})
}

var _ = fmt.Sprint

-- index.gohtml --
{{define "greeting"}}Hi {{template "name" .}}{{end}}
{{define "name"}}{{.Title}}{{end}}
